all_posted.description: Whether every statement line of the dispute has posted; a draft is prepared only when they all have.

credited.description: What a customer credit was settled against it.

disputed.description: The disputed amount alone, without the dispute fee.

held.description: What its posted lines have moved into disputes clearing and the provider has not given back.

loss_document_id.description: The draft journal prepared to write it off.

over_limit.description: Whether it is above the limit up to which a lost dispute is written off as an expense without a reason (psp.dispute_expense_limit).

settlement_id.description: The refund document that settled the customer credit against it (dispute_settlement@1).

status.description: open: its money waits; won: the provider gave it all back; written_off: a draft journal was prepared to write it off; credited: a customer credit was settled against all of it.
